proceedings.outcome: the applicant was arrested, questioned and released
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 April 1995 at about 8.30 p.m. the applicant, driving a car, was arrested in Slovenj Gradec by officers of the Special Unit and the Slovenj Gradec Police. He was brought to the Slovenj Gradec Police Station for having allegedly failed to comply with the police orders. He was questioned by the police and released on 6 April 1995 at approximately half past midnight.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant made an oral complaint against the officers
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 7 April 1995 the applicant went to the Slovenj Gradec Police and made an oral complaint against the officers of the Special Unit concerning the events of 5 April 1995.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant lodged a written criminal complaint
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 15 May 1995 the applicant lodged, through his lawyer, a written criminal complaint ( kazenska ovadba ) with the Slovenj Gradec Police against unidentified police officers for causing minor bodily harm ( lahka telesna poškodba ) and an unlawful deprivation of liberty ( protipraven odvzem prostosti ).

proceedings.outcome: established that all the measures and procedures were lawful and there were no grounds for suspicion that the officers committed criminal offences
proceedings.supporting_quote: Subsequently, two reports concerning the relevant police operation were submitted to the Public Prosecutor: one by the MIA on 15 November 1995... the working group established that all the measures and procedures were lawful and in accordance with legal powers and professional rules. (...) there are no grounds for suspicion that the officers of the special working group of the Criminal Police Directorate [the officers of the Slovenj Gradec Police and the Special Unit] committed the alleged criminal offences

proceedings.outcome: the report corresponded to the facts as submitted by the Government
proceedings.supporting_quote: Subsequently, two reports concerning the relevant police operation were submitted to the Public Prosecutor: one by the MIA on 15 November 1995 and one by the Slovenj Gradec Police on 5 February 1996.

proceedings.deciding_body: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office
proceedings.outcome: the applicant's criminal complaint was dismissed
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 17 January 1997 the Public Prosecutor issued a decision dismissing the applicant’s criminal complaint.
parties: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office

proceedings.outcome: decided not to open a criminal investigation against the applicant
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 8 May 1997, further to a proposal of the investigating judge, the Slovenj Gradec District Court decided not to open a criminal investigation against the applicant.

proceedings.outcome: upheld the Public Prosecutor's appeal and opened a criminal investigation against the applicant
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 4 December 1997 the Maribor Higher Court upheld her appeal finding that, despite the shortcomings mentioned in the first-instance decision, there were sufficient grounds for suspicion that the applicant had committed the alleged offence. Accordingly, it changed the first-instance court’s decision and opened a criminal investigation against the applicant.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant's objection to the indictment was rejected
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 27 January 1999 the applicant filed an objection to the indictment. (...) His objection was rejected by the Slovenj Gradec District Court on 16 February 1999.
By a judgment of 22 November 1999 the court acquitted the applicant.

proceedings.outcome: quashed the judgment and remitted the case to a new panel for retrial
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 January 2000 the Public Prosecutor appealed against the judgment and on 27 September 2000 the Maribor Higher Court quashed the judgment and remitted the case to a new panel for retrial.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant was convicted and sentenced to 3 months’ imprisonment, suspended for 3 years
proceedings.supporting_quote: By a judgment of 12 February 2001, the Slovenj Gradec District Court convicted the applicant as charged and sentenced him to 3 months’ imprisonment, suspended for 3 years.

proceedings.outcome: upheld the conviction but amended the judgment with respect to the costs of the proceedings
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 9 May 2001 the Maribor Higher Court upheld the conviction but amended the judgment with respect to the costs of the proceedings.

proceedings.outcome: ordered the applicant to pay an additional sum to cover the costs of one of the witnesses
proceedings.supporting_quote: Lastly, on 11 October 2001 the Slovenj Gradec District Court ordered the applicant to pay an additional sum to cover the costs of one of the witnesses heard during the proceedings.
